shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -50

cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html vite.config.ts tsconfig.json .gitignore && echo ---- && cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs && echo ---- && ls node_modules | head -80 && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components | head -120

ls node_modules/@uiw node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/lab && ls node_modules | sed -n '80,200p' && ls node_modules | grep -iE 'mark|remark|rehype|dompurify|sanitize' ; grep -rl "markdown" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components --include=*.d.ts | head; cat node_modules/@uiw/*/package.json 2>/dev/null | grep -E '"(name|version|peerDependencies|dependencies)"' -A3 | head -40

(timeout 15 npm view marked version 2>&1 | tail -2; echo "exit=$?") & cd /home/sandbox/workspace && sed -n '1,200p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextArea/TextArea.d.ts; sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/types.d.ts; wait

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components; ls $U/layout; sed -n '1,80p' $U/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts; echo ----TEXT; sed -n '1,60p' $U/Text/Text.d.ts; grep -n "variant\|color" $U/Text/text.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30; ls $U/Text; echo ----CARD; sed -n '1,40p' $U/Card/Card.d.ts; echo ----LINK; sed -n '1,30p' $U/Link/Link.d.ts; echo ----LABEL; grep -n "theme\|size" $U/Label/Label.d.ts | head; echo ---TABS; ls $U/tabs; sed -n '1,60p' $U/tabs/Tab*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -80

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components; grep -n "TEXT_VARIANTS\|'header-\|'body-\|'code-\|'caption-\|'subheader-\|'display-" $U/Text/text/text.d.ts $U/Text/text/*.d.ts | head -20; grep -n "TEXT_COLORS\|'secondary'\|'hint'\|'danger'\|'complementary'" $U/Text/colorText/*.d.ts | head; grep -nE "export \* from .*(Flex|Card|TextArea|Text|Link|Label|Button|Divider|TextInput|layout|controls)" $U/index.d.ts; grep -n "css-ignore\|--g-color-base-generic\|--g-color-line-generic\|--g-color-base-misc\|--g-color-text-link\b" $U/theme/styles/*.css 2>/dev/null | head -5; ls $U/theme; grep -rhoE "\-\-g-color-(base-generic|line-generic|base-misc-light|text-(primary|secondary|hint|complementary))" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/*.css $U/theme/styles/*.css 2>/dev/null | sort -u | head

npm run build 2>&1 | tail -15; which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome playwright 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; node -e "try{require.resolve('playwright');console.log('playwright ok')}catch{console.log('no playwright')}"
